scenario: Standard salary below RM5,000 — single Malaysian employee
input: Gross: RM3,000 | Status: Single | Nationality: Malaysian | Bonus: RM0
expected: EPF: RM330 | SOCSO: RM29.75 | EIS: RM7.50 | PCB: RM0 | Net: ~RM2,632.75
notes: Most common use case. Verify all deductions correct.

scenario: Standard salary above RM5,000 — single Malaysian employee
input: Gross: RM6,000 | Status: Single | Nationality: Malaysian | Bonus: RM0
expected: EPF: RM660 (11%) | Employer EPF: RM720 (12%) | SOCSO: capped | EIS: capped | PCB: ~RM200+ | Net: ~RM5,041
notes: Employer EPF drops to 12% above RM5,000.

input: Gross: RM4,000 | Status: Married | Nationality: Malaysian | Bonus: RM0
expected: PCB lower than equivalent single employee. Net pay higher than TC-001.
notes: Marital status reduces PCB. EPF/SOCSO/EIS unchanged.

input: Gross: RM5,000 | Bonus: RM5,000 | Status: Single | Nationality: Malaysian
expected: EPF calculated on RM10,000 total. PCB recalculated with bonus annualisation. Total deductions increase significantly.
notes: Bonus must be added to gross before PCB annualisation calculation.

input: Gross: RM5,000 | Status: Single | Nationality: Non-Malaysian | Bonus: RM0
expected: EPF applies. SOCSO: not applicable. EIS: not applicable. PCB applies at standard rate.
notes: Non-citizens exempt from SOCSO and EIS contributions.

input: Gross: RM1,700 | Status: Single | Nationality: Malaysian | Bonus: RM0
expected: EPF: RM187 | SOCSO: RM16.35 | EIS: RM4.25 | PCB: RM0 | Net: ~RM1,492.40
notes: PCB is RM0 at this income level. Common real-world scenario.

scenario: Download Salary Report button triggers form
input: Complete calculator, click Download Salary Report
expected: Modal appears asking for email, user type, hiring status, company, phone. Form submits and records to Google Sheets.
notes: Check Google Sheet for new row after submission.

input: Complete calculator, click Download Salary Payslip
expected: Same modal as TC-007. download_via column = 'Download Salary Payslip' in Google Sheet.
notes: Verify download_via value is correct for this button.

input: Gross: RM5,000 | Status: Single | Nationality: Malaysian
expected: Employer EPF at 13% (not 12%). SOCSO and EIS at correct band. No rounding errors.
notes: Boundary condition. RM5,000 must use 13% employer rate, not 12%.

input: Gross: RM5,000.01 | Status: Single | Nationality: Malaysian
expected: Employer EPF switches to 12%. All other deductions recalculate correctly.
notes: One cent above threshold must change employer EPF rate.

input: Gross: RM8,000 | Status: Single | Nationality: Malaysian
expected: SOCSO employee: RM69.05 (capped). SOCSO employer: RM175.35 (capped). No further increase above ceiling.
notes: SOCSO ceiling is RM5,000 per month wage.

input: Gross: RM10,000 | Status: Single | Nationality: Malaysian
expected: EIS employee: RM29.85 (capped). EIS employer: RM29.85 (capped). No further increase.
notes: EIS ceiling is RM5,000 per month wage.

input: Gross: RM50,000 | Status: Single | Nationality: Malaysian | Bonus: RM0
expected: EPF: RM5,500 | SOCSO capped | EIS capped | PCB at top bracket | Net significantly reduced.
notes: Verify no overflow or NaN in result display.

scenario: Large bonus with low base salary
input: Gross: RM3,000 | Bonus: RM20,000 | Status: Single | Nationality: Malaysian
expected: PCB spikes significantly due to bonus annualisation formula. EPF calculated on total RM23,000.
notes: Bonus annualisation formula must apply correctly.

input: Gross: RM3,500.50 | Status: Single | Nationality: Malaysian
expected: All deductions calculated to 2 decimal places. No rounding errors. Net pay correct.
notes: Test floating point precision.

input: Gross: (empty) | Click Calculate
expected: Error logged via logError('input'). Result card does not display. No crash. Console shows error entry.
notes: Type 'errorlogs' on page after test to verify log was captured.

input: Gross: -3000 | Status: Single
expected: Input rejected or treated as RM0. Error logged. No negative deductions shown.
notes: Calculator must never produce negative deduction values.

input: Gross: 'abc' | Click Calculate
expected: Field rejects input or shows RM0. Error logged with type 'input'. No crash.
notes: Browser may block non-numeric. Verify logError still fires.

input: Gross: '@@##' | Click Calculate
expected: Input sanitised to 0 or rejected. No crash. Error logged.
notes: Check that special chars cannot break the calculation logic.

input: Gross: RM0 | Status: Single | Nationality: Malaysian
expected: All deductions = RM0. Net = RM0. No divide-by-zero crash. Page remains stable.
notes: Divide-by-zero must be handled gracefully.

input: Gross: RM999,999,999 | Status: Single
expected: Calculator handles without overflow or NaN. Displays result at top PCB bracket. No page crash.
notes: Test JavaScript number limits.

scenario: Page loads correctly on mobile (375px width)
input: Open site on iPhone or resize browser to 375px
expected: All elements visible and not overlapping. Calculator usable. No horizontal scroll.
notes: Use Chrome DevTools device mode to simulate mobile.

input: Enter valid salary, click Calculate
expected: Page smoothly scrolls to result card. All values (EPF, SOCSO, EIS, PCB, Net) displayed clearly.
notes: Smooth scroll behaviour must work on mobile too.

input: Click Privacy Policy in footer
expected: Navigates to /privacy-policy. Page loads correctly. No 404 error.
notes: Previously had 404 issue. Must verify in production.

input: Open https://salarycalculator.my in browser
expected: Ricebowl logo appears in browser tab. Visible on both desktop and mobile.
notes: Check on Chrome, Safari and Firefox.

input: Open https://salarycalculator.my on a standard connection
expected: Page fully interactive in under 3 seconds. No blank screen delay.
notes: Use Chrome Lighthouse or PageSpeed Insights to measure.

input: Enter valid salary, click Calculate
expected: Result appears in under 500ms. No visible lag or spinner needed.
notes: All calculation is client-side so should be near-instant.

input: Leave salary blank, click Calculate. Then type 'errorlogs' on page.
expected: Popup shows one log entry with type='input' and message='Invalid salary input'.
notes: Primary way to verify error logging is working.

scenario: Error logs persist after page refresh
input: Trigger an error, refresh the page, type 'errorlogs'
expected: Previously logged errors still visible. localStorage persists across refresh.
notes: Confirms localStorage is used correctly.

input: Open error log viewer, click 'Clear All Logs'
expected: All logs removed. Viewer shows 'No errors logged yet' message.
notes: Verify clearErrorLogs() empties localStorage key.
